name: Projected Terminal Find Surface
description: Provides bounded, keyboard-first search of retained content for one projected terminal client.

states: Inspect deterministic completed, searching, and invalid-expression states with localized status output.
Use the query field, option toggles, match navigation controls, and Escape close behavior entirely by keyboard.

useWhen: A single projected terminal client must search only content retained by its Terminal Host attachment.
avoidWhen: Search spans Workbench Actions, settings, projects, or multiple providers instead of one terminal buffer.
invariants: Opening the surface does not create a search Worker until a non-empty query survives the debounce.
Search status never exposes raw terminal content or engine error text as product-facing copy.
Closing the surface restores terminal focus and discards no more than twenty in-memory query-history entries.
